metadata.description: For local, worktree-first repositories: queue committed branches from parallel coding agents, test the combined tree in order, keep integration pushes under one human-gated owner, and recover interrupted pushes. Not for single-agent work or PR-first repositories already using GitHub Merge Queue or GitLab Merge Trains.

plugins.name: mergetrain
plugins.description: Queue committed branches from parallel coding-agent worktrees, test the combined tree in order, give integration pushes one approval-gated owner, and recover interrupted Git pushes.
